title: The Coach Ride Up
h1: Chapter I, cues 31–35 · The Coach Ride Up

beats.name: Inside the coach
beats.prompt: cinematic film still, interior of a crowded old mail coach in afternoon light, a young English solicitor, grown man of twenty-five, strong adult jaw, travelling coat, sitting among Carpathian peasant passengers in sheepskins and embroidered shawls, an old woman fingering a rosary, men glancing at him uneasily, blossoming orchards passing the small window --ar 16:9 --sref https://ianingram.github.io/Amenti-Readings/dracula/art/ch01-d16-1.jpg --oref https://ianingram.github.io/Amenti-Readings/dracula/art/ref/bk3-jonathan.jpg --no child, boy, abstract

beats.name: Flying over the rugged road
beats.words: The road was rugged, but still we seemed to fly over it with a feverish haste.
beats.prompt: cinematic film still, low close three-quarter view, a heavy old Carpathian mail coach of dark weathered wood, luggage piled on the roof, great leather springs, four horses, the driver in a sheepskin coat and broad black hat, racing along a rutted spring road between blossoming apple and cherry orchards, petals and dust flying from the wheels, horses straining, green hills behind, afternoon sun --ar 16:9 --sref https://ianingram.github.io/Amenti-Readings/dracula/art/ch01-d16-1.jpg --no abstract, cars, modern

beats.at: The only stop he would make
beats.name: Lighting the lamps
beats.words: The only stop he would make was a moment’s pause to light his lamps.
beats.prompt: cinematic film still, dusk on a mountain road in the Carpathians, a heavy old Carpathian mail coach of dark weathered wood, luggage piled on the roof, great leather springs, four horses, the driver in a sheepskin coat and broad black hat halted for a moment, the driver standing on the step lighting the coach lamp with a match, warm flame against the cold blue twilight, the horses breathing steam, pine woods and late snow behind, faces of passengers at the coach window --ar 16:9 --sref https://ianingram.github.io/Amenti-Readings/dracula/art/ch01-d16-1.jpg --no abstract, modern

beats.name: The driver lashes the horses
beats.words: He lashed the horses unmercifully with his long whip, and with wild cries of encouragement urged them on to further exertions.
beats.prompt: cinematic film still, night, low angle from the road, a heavy old Carpathian mail coach of dark weathered wood, luggage piled on the roof, great leather springs, four horses, the driver in a sheepskin coat and broad black hat hurtling toward the camera, the driver standing and cracking a long whip over four galloping horses, coach lamps blazing, mud and stones flying, dark mountains closing in --ar 16:9 --sref https://ianingram.github.io/Amenti-Readings/dracula/art/ch01-d16-1.jpg --no abstract, modern

beats.at: the crazy coach rocked on its great leather springs
beats.name: The coach rocks like a boat
beats.words: the crazy coach rocked on its great leather springs, and swayed like a boat tossed on a stormy sea. I had to hold on.
beats.prompt: cinematic film still, night, side view of a heavy old Carpathian mail coach of dark weathered wood, luggage piled on the roof, great leather springs, four horses, the driver in a sheepskin coat and broad black hat lurching and swaying violently on its leather springs over a rough mountain road, tilted, lamps swinging, passengers clinging inside, motion blur on the wheels --ar 16:9 --sref https://ianingram.github.io/Amenti-Readings/dracula/art/ch01-d16-1.jpg --no abstract, modern

beats.at: craning over the edge of the coach
beats.name: Peering into the dark
beats.words: on each side the passengers, craning over the edge of the coach, peered eagerly into the darkness.
beats.prompt: cinematic film still, night in the Borgo Pass, close on the side of a speeding old mail coach, peasant passengers in sheepskins leaning out of both windows peering anxiously ahead into the darkness, lamplight on their faces, the driver leaning forward on his box, black cliffs above --ar 16:9 --sref https://ianingram.github.io/Amenti-Readings/dracula/art/ch01-d16-1.jpg --no abstract, modern

beats.at: the steam from our hard-driven horses rose in a white cloud
beats.name: Steaming horses on the white road
beats.words: The only light was the flickering rays of our own lamps, in which the steam from our hard-driven horses rose in a white cloud. We could see now the sandy road lying white before us, but there was on it no sign of a vehicle.
beats.prompt: cinematic film still, night at the top of the Borgo Pass, a heavy old Carpathian mail coach of dark weathered wood, luggage piled on the roof, great leather springs, four horses, the driver in a sheepskin coat and broad black hat pulled up on a white sandy road, steam rising in a white cloud from the four hard-driven horses in the coach lamplight, the empty road ahead vanishing into blackness, heavy thunderclouds overhead --ar 16:9 --sref https://ianingram.github.io/Amenti-Readings/dracula/art/ch01-d16-1.jpg --no abstract, modern, other vehicles
